parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is the social change?","marks":1,"answer":"Social change is the overall change in the living system of a nation.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Explain one reason of social change in Bangladesh.","marks":2,"answer":"One of the most important reasons of social change in Bangladesh is industrialization. As a result of industrialization, people’s standard of lifestyle has been enhanced. Rural joint families are breaking apart and nuclear families are being formed in the city. Financial independence has increased in the society. Women have come out of their houses and are being employed in production factories alongside men.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"The impact of what factor has resemblance to the social changes created by ‘Shorbodoya’ and Sromodana’ programmes? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"Social changes created by the influence of programs ‘Shorbodoya’ and ‘Sromodana’ have similarities with the influence of the element of education. Education is a type of reformation achievement and an unending process. The expansion of education awakens self-confidence and power of consideration in the members of society. Through education, the conditions of the backward populace have changed. Currently, through the ‘Sromodana’ program, the custom of dowry and child marriage has decreased much in the Bogra region. Expansion of women’s education has created awareness among people, which has inspired various social movements. parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is the special element of social change?","marks":1,"answer":"Education is the special element of social change.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Technology is the applied side of science’ – Explain it.","marks":2,"answer":"Technology is the applied side of science. Science is applied in our everyday life through various technologies.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Explain which elements of social changes are in table A.","marks":3,"answer":"The ‘A’ in the stem indicates some of the natural components of social change. Bangladesh’s geographical position is one of the major reasons behind its social changes. The sudden geographical and climate changes impact the people of this country and bring about many changes in society. Natural disasters like floods, river erosion, cyclones, tornados, excessive rain, etc. are very common in this country. As these disasters destroy the social balance, several measures need to be taken to cope with the social changes. This leads to changes in the behaviours of people. For example, river erosion is one of the main reasons why slums appear in cities. The slums create many problems for the cities. The cities undergo major changes as several government and non-government organizations take up different projects to solve the problems.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"The elements which are reflected in table B are the main important elements of social change’ – Explain the quote.","marks":4,"answer":"The components reflected in table ‘B’ are industrialization and urbanization. These components are the main components of social change. Industrialization is such a process that transforms an agriculture-based economy and social system into an economy and society based on industries and production. Industrialization leads to urbanization and people from the rural areas come to live in cities. Roads are repaired and built as communications get a boost due to industrialization and urbanization. These two lessen the geographical distance but widen the social gap. Many people are joining the factories leaving their agricultural work. Men and women are working together. People’s behaviour, values, and mentality are changing. Because of low payment, people no longer can live in joint families. So they are forming small families. Industrialization has created three social classes in our society – high, middle, and low classes. The change in the organic state of the people of the society such as the increase and decrease in population, the change in migration, or the destiny of population play an important role in the social change.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Explain the components of social change mentioned in \"A\" given above.","marks":3,"answer":"The components of social change mentioned in ‘A’ indicate some of the natural components of social change. Bangladesh’s geographical position is one of the major reasons behind its social changes. The sudden geographical and climate changes impact the people of this country and bring about many changes in society. Natural disasters like floods, river erosion, cyclones, tornados, excessive rain, etc. are very common in this country. As these disasters destroy the social balance, several measures need to be taken to cope with the social changes. This leads to changes in the behaviours of people. For example, river erosion is one of the main reasons why slums appear in cities. In the stem, global warming, river erosion, and cyclones are mentioned which are the natural components of social change.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"\"The components reflected in table 'B' are the most important components of social change.\" - Analyze the statement.","marks":4,"answer":"The components reflected in Table ‘B’ are industrialization and urbanization factors which are the most important components of social change. Industrialization has a significant impact on the change of profession in society. People of the village area move towards the city and shift their professions to support their families. There is also a drastic change that occurs as a result of urbanization. The shift in family structure is representative of the transformation from traditional, extended family setups prevalent in rural areas to more nuclear and independent households in urban settings. Economic factors, primarily the promise of jobs and financial stability in cities, fuel this transition, showcasing the powerful pull of industrialization and urbanization on family dynamics. This aspect highlights how industrialization and urbanization can inadvertently promote gender equality, disrupting traditional gender roles and expectations. Nonetheless, this societal metamorphosis is not without its challenges. Striking a balance between professional commitments and familial responsibilities is one such hurdle. The demands of urban jobs often require extensive working hours and commuting, leaving couples grappling with the need to manage their careers while nurturing family ties. Additionally, the social distance that emerges in urban spaces, where time is spent more with colleagues and neighbours than extended family, can potentially affect the depth of intimacy and support within the family unit.\n---","image":null,"image_url":null}]

This matter has changed the role of women in society through women’s empowerment. Social change is taking place as a result of a change in women’s role in society.\n---","image":null,"image_url":null}]

parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is technology?","marks":1,"answer":"Technology is the applied side of science.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"Explain the role of women in social change.","marks":2,"answer":"The role of women in social change is immense. Women play an important role in this transformation of society. Women are now getting an education as well as becoming involved in various fields of work. Educated women are working in different professions like medical, law, teacher, police, various government and non-government organizations, etc. At the rural level, women are taking loans from government or non-government organizations and creating self-employment opportunities. Thus, women play an important role in society.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Which element of social change indicates in event-1? Explain.","marks":3,"answer":"Event 1 indicates the natural factor of social change. Society is constantly changing. The social structure and its activities change every day and take a new form. Some factors are acting as important influencers behind these changes. Among them, the natural factor is one. In event 1 of the stem, the indication of the mentioned factor is noticeable. Agricultural production has lessened due to tidal surges in the last few years. As a result, people’s purchasing power has decreased. From this, we can understand that there has been some sort of social change due to the natural disaster of the tidal surge. This indicates the natural factor of social change. Natural disasters like river erosion, tidal surges, floods, tornadoes, drought, heavy rainfall, etc. destroy the environmental balance. New methods are needed to be accepted to adapt to the new environment. Consequently, the social relationship between people changes. For example, river erosion is one of the reasons for the growth of slums in urban areas in our country. The growth of slums in urban areas has given rise to many other problems. Many changes have taken place in the city society as many government and non-government activities have been adopted to solve this problem. This is how natural disasters keep creating new problems. People adopt diverse activities to deal with such problems which continue to bring about change in society.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"\"For the social change of Bangladesh the element of event-2 has a great impact\" Analyze.","marks":4,"answer":"The elements of event 2 that is the industrialization and urbanization factors have a massive impact in the case of the social change in Bangladesh. Industrialization is such a process by which an agriculture-based economy and social system is transformed into a mechanical industry-based and production-oriented economy and society. Urbanization is the outcome of industrialization. In event 2 the indication towards both these factors of social change is noticeable. In event 2 we see that Mr. X leaves his parents in the village with his brother and comes to the city. Both husband and wife get jobs at an organization. In this case, the impact of industrialization and urbanization on social change can be noticed in Mr. X. Industrialization and urbanization are playing a massive role in Bangladesh’s social change. Due to the expansion of industries, many skilled and unskilled laborers have arrived from rural areas to the cities in search of jobs and accepted city life. Transportation and communication systems have developed due to industrialization and urbanization. Although this has decreased geographical distance, it has increased the social distance. It is not possible to live in the city with all family members due to lack of accommodation, low wages, etc. Consequently, joint families have broken down and nuclear/single families have been formed. Various other problems have also arisen like divorce, problems in the appropriate socialization of children and adolescents, the tendency to commit crime, etc.\n---","image":null,"image_url":null}]

Through the introduction and advancement of technology, both the mindset of people living within a social system and the social structure experience vital changes. What Google does is help Internet users find the required information from the unlimited amount of information saved in billions of computers all over the world. Its contributions to bringing about social changes have been undeniably significant.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"When it comes to social change, the communication medium shown in diagram 2 is both a blessing and a curse – present your opinions regarding this statement.","marks":4,"answer":"The statement that the communication medium shown in diagram 2 i.e. Facebook is both a blessing and a curse when it comes to social change is accurate. One can communicate with many other people simultaneously through the use of Facebook. Besides, this platform plays a great role in helping people find blood for seriously ill patients, helping students and organizing social protests against injustice and unfairness. On the other hand, excessive use of Facebook wastes valuable time for the students. Many users even get addicted to this platform and stop functioning normally. Virtual crimes of varying natures and patterns have become easier with the help of Facebook. Sometimes criminals hack users’ accounts and misuse them for their own selfish purpose. A lot of users become victims of fraud on this site. Also, offensive pictures or videos of users, if uploaded on the site, can lead to social unrest. Whether it is a blessing or a curse depends mostly on its users. If used with care, Facebook can prove to be a blessing to humans at all times.\n---","image":null,"image_url":null}]

parts: [{"label":"A","letter":"A","text":"What is called the fundamental organization of a social structure?","marks":1,"answer":"The family is the fundamental organization of a social structure.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"B","letter":"B","text":"What is social values?","marks":2,"answer":"The values are specific features of our social life. The standard of people's life style can be measured through these values, because, by exercising these values, a man's conduct becomes obvious regarding social rules and regulations, norms, customs, respect for social laws, etc. The social values are our common cultural ideals. views, needs, good and bad aspect of people in the society can be assessed through these ideals.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"C","letter":"C","text":"Discuss the feature of the family of Roni-Romana couple based on their living.","marks":3,"answer":"The features of the family of Romana-Roni couple based on dwelling place which has been focused in the stem are matrilocal and neo-local family. Based on their families of this kind, there can be three types of families: patrilocal, matrilocal and neo-local. The family where the newly married couple live in the husband's father's house is called patrilocal family. It is commonly seen in our social system. Matrilocal family is the type of family where the newly married couple live in the wife's father's house. This type of family is not common and usually in our society this type of family is looked down upon. Roni and Romanas first family was this type. The married couple does not live either with the husband's or with the wife's paternal house; rather they live in a new place which is known as neolocal family. This type of family is found within the service holders of urban areas. Roni and Roman's present family is of this type.","image":null,"image_url":null},{"label":"D","letter":"D","text":"Presence of special element of social changes is notable in the activities of Romana- Analyze.","marks":4,"answer":"Presence of the special element of social changes that is notable in Romana's activities is education. A special factor of social change is education. Education is the making of one kind of reform and easeless process. The spread of education among the members of the society arouses the self-confidence, the power of judgement and consideration. Education liberates us from all kinds of blindness, ignorance, superstition, etc. For example, the expansion of female education in the society of Bangladesh has created awareness among the people which has motivated various social movements. So, in the establishment of women rights in Bangladesh, various social policies and laws have been formulated. The Dowry Act, the family laws, the women development policy, etc. are the outcome of social awareness. The female education has made women eligible for outdoor work and made them tend to do jobs. As a result women empowerment has taken place. In this way, the education of science and commerce, etc. has created many things in social life, which have played an important role in the positive change of the society.","image":null,"image_url":null}]
